semiconductor_relevance: High — Physix Technology specializes in advanced equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in areas like wafer level packaging and optical integrated circuits.
summary: Physix Technology provides cutting-edge equipment solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on precision stages and systems for applications such as fiber alignment and microassembly. Their products include piezo stages, linear motor stages, and maskless exposure systems designed for high performance and versatility in semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Maskless exposure systems with a minimum drawing resolution of 1.5 μm
